message: 世界の入口
Yeah, exams start tomorrow, so I'll study at the library today.
Sunlight streaming through the windows and the electric lamps illuminate the walls and bookshelves in an amber glow.
There are more students than usual, yet it's quieter than I expected.
Most of the people sitting at the reading tables aren't regulars. Rather than coming to borrow books or read, they're probably using the library for self-study.
In situations like this, friends tend to start chatting with each other and it gets noisy, but--
Miss Melilot is pacing back and forth between the bookshelves with several books in her arms.
Careless chatter in front of this librarian is strictly taboo. Any student who regularly frequents the library knows that much.
They know Miss Melilot's behavior is actually surveillance under the pretext of organizing the collection.
Normally, Miss Melilot walks silently across the fully carpeted floor, yet during this period when many students come for self-study, she deliberately lets her footsteps echo.
That said, it doesn't mean she's in a bad mood. The way she handles books is careful and efficient, and her voice possesses a gentleness that blends right into the library's silence.

name: Eddie
message: 「Aaah~, what a drag. Screw studying for exams.」
Eddie, who had been looking sluggishly at his textbook at a reading table, accidentally mutters the forbidden words.

name: Melilot
message: 「Then you have no business in the library.」
...It's strictly her tone of voice that remains calm; the content itself is merciless.

name: Eddie
message: 「Eek!? Y-You've got it wrong! My tongue just slipped a little--」

name: Melilot
message: 「I order you to leave.」
Miss Melilot's hand softly touches the nape of Eddie's neck.
The instant she does, Eddie faints and collapses onto the floor.
Two burly library committee members immediately arrive and haul Eddie away toward the entrance.
I have no idea what kind of technique that is, though rumor has it Sacchin mastered this secret art just by watching and imitating her.
...Even if she's scary, as long as you observe proper library etiquette, nobody is more helpful than Miss Melilot.
I find an open seat at a reading table and promptly sit down.

name: Shio
message: 「Zzz... zzz... snooze~~」
N-No way, Shio is dozing off right across from me.

name: Synn
message: 「S-Shio...?」
Actually, yes way.
It looks like Shio-chan didn't come here for self-study, but to read. There are no textbooks, notebooks, or writing utensils in front of her--just a single paperback left open and face-down.
In the library, if you carelessly leave something out without putting it away, Melilot-san will immediately spot you and dish out a punishment.
No matter how small the item is, you have to return it to its designated spot.

name: Shio
message: 「Zzz... Zzz... Zzz...」
The single exception is books.
Even if a student leaves a half-read book open and face-down on a reading desk, Melilot-san will never put it away on her own.
One must not touch it carelessly. Lest the student lose their way.
Because an unknown world still lies hidden on the other side of the page, and the book's face-down shape marks the entrance to the rest of that world--
Yes, Melilot-san understands this well.

name: Shio
message: 「Zzz, zzz, zzz」

name: Melilot
message: 「Hehe...」

name: Shio
message: 「Kihin!? Mm... mmm, mm?」
Melilot-san gives Shio-chan a single flick on the forehead.
Alright, time to get to work. I'd love to see more of her gentle punishments, but I really need to study.
